# Don’t think about the next step. Take it.

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/8627ab2a3505bdfc258dad893605f7fb7bb4a751-2700x1800.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

First agenda item of the day? Open your laptop and launch Dia.

Before calendar invites, the Slack DMs, and your emails in your inbox can flood in, your new tab shows you a short list of **Proactive Suggestions.**

These are a few things, just for you, based on what you were already in the middle of—and a preview of what might be coming up next, such as...

The notes from yesterday’s 1:1

so you can follow up while it’s still fresh, and make sure that all your agenda items actually get done.

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/daa11209813d15ec38f1db7f76a6a4c6729261cc-1200x900.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

The Figma file you’re presenting

in your 10am meeting. Instead of hunting down the tab, you're practicing what edits were made on RND 3.

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/34cd5750a29c615dcdb562b335ac69d23fdbac1e-1200x900.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

The LinkedIn message

you missed but actually want to respond to. No need to circle back to Christina after working hours.

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/acab51a74d32ddccd1fac710c97240acad6b42ec-1200x900.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

Instead of starting your the day remembering where to begin, Dia makes you first click obvious. Your priorities are visible, actionable, and ready when you are.

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/e94fd2f121218c8ec8935b2149dbdaf64b8a2b6d-900x900.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

Not ready to tackle Dia's suggestion? Dismiss it or let it fade away naturally.

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/f0f6374f01de2fb6f3e99776a270dce689dff7be-1476x1286.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

If you’d rather keep a totally clean new tab page, turn off Proactive Suggestions anytime in Personalization settings.

Sometimes the best morning means less thinking, and more doing. Now you have a browser to meet you where you left off.

A few more updates

- **Performance improvements that pack a punch.** We’ve heard some reports on sluggishness and memory leaks, especially when opening new tabs. Our recent fixes should improve performance dramatically—but if something is still not working, go to “Help”, then “Record Performance Issue". It really helps us repro!
- **Switch profiles, fast.** Quickly switch between profiles using keyboard shortcuts (e.g. ctrl + 1, 2, 3, ...), to handle your different personas with ease.
- **Shortcut to Chat and Search.** Open the command bar and route directly to Chat with **⌃⌘** or to Google Search with **⇧⌘**. Skip that extra typing and selecting step.

### OneLastThing

While I’m still obsessed with the [BNCY Faves](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3LcnXEp2YCn3aMoJBEcy5K?si=aa45383c097e463f) playlist (and our Spotify Feature), I’ve been finding new music through [Quinton Mulvey’s](https://open.spotify.com/user/1214127060?si=af377151db964e81) series Queue. I love that the corresponding [Substack](https://quintonmulvey.substack.com/) explains the history and choice behind each song selection.

![](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/b7717ca7c7f8a2bdb1442281c3442e1493ac0722-3024x4032.jpg)

Recommended by

Ariel Levin

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/5f49ed7e9673c2bb820bb729c012382d61200801-1100x1100.jpg?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

# Notes from the roadmap

![](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/1ff2f1d077290674fc5560c0e80981bc99dcea8d-3352x2100.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&h=500&fit=crop&dpr=2)

![](https://www.diabrowser.com/images/release-notes/postcard/postcard-back.png)![](https://www.diabrowser.com/images/release-notes/postcard/stamp-brooklyn.png)![](https://www.diabrowser.com/images/release-notes/postcard/postmark.png)

Greetings from Brooklyn!

I can barely remember a world before AI meeting notes, but the magic really started when I added Granola to my connected tools in Dia. Now, when I finish a meeting, I just ask Dia: **“Update the team tracker in Notion with the meeting notes from standup.”** and voila, meeting notes and everyone's to-dos right into our project tracker.

— Kyle

### Howtoconnectyourtools

Go into **Settings > Apps** and turn **New Chat** on. Then you can connect Granola and all your other tools!

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/e1bf3dab180417d7a13174091175d6be720f79c2-854x612.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

# What we're building, unfiltered

Starting today, we're rededicating this space to highlighting the newest and most exciting features that we're building. Some of you are already using these features. Some of you have heard whispers. Some of you typed in a secret code and never quite figured out if it was on.

The industry is selling a life with nothing left in it for you to do. An agent to work on your behalf, an assistant to decide on your behalf, a day smoothed down until it asks nothing of you and gives nothing back. [We were founded on a different premise.](https://browsercompany.substack.com/p/optimizing-for-feelings)

We believe in making good work _feel_ good, and that life is better when you demand more from it, friction and all, rather than having it automated away. That's why we're showing you our latest, unfiltered, sometimes-rough-around-the-edges features this summer.

Starting with better mornings...

0:00 / 0:00

Mornings are their own small defeat. You open the laptop and it's all already waiting: the forty tabs you left for some better-rested version of yourself, the thread that reached a decision without you, the email you've put off so long that answering it now is practically a confession. It makes you want to scream. We think it shouldn't have to feel like that, so we built the **Morning Brief**.

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/c3d36d730ae27bc17c442ca372a31a88a509f3f1-1600x1063.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

It remembers what slipped through the cracks, what deserves your focus, and quiets the storm long enough for you to start the day on your terms.

### GetyourMorningBrief

Go into **Settings > Apps** and turn **New Chat** on. Connect your tools and you'll receive your first one tomorrow. (We need Slack at a minimum, but connect more for a richer brief!)

![Dia Browser](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/e5fj2khm/production/e1bf3dab180417d7a13174091175d6be720f79c2-854x612.png?auto=format&q=100&w=800&dpr=2)

Things may not be perfect, they may break, and crash, and give you wonky outputs, so we're excited to explore the friction with you.

More next week!

Hello from Manhattan, NY

Every company's kit looks different. At BCNY, ours is mostly Slack and GSuite (and now Atlassian!). That's where decisions get made, insights are shared, and plans are developed. But at my first job, it was Microsoft all the way.

With Dia's new suite of Microsoft tools, that same power opens up for a lot more teams. A couple of things that now just work: a heads-up in your morning brief when a doc updates in SharePoint and asking Dia what's happening in Teams.

![- Jane](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

I love having Dia comb through my disparate work tools to make a cohesive writeup in Notion. Just ask and Dia wrangles Slack dms, long email threads, and messy Google Docs (and more) with ease.

This came in particularly handy for performance reviews this Summer: “ _Searching across our tools, find me conversations where Susan's communication and leadership skills excelled this Summer, collecting it all in a Notion doc for me to review.”_
